description:
-= Recreation Zone =-
You arrive in a recreation zone. The room is well lit.

You can see a closed safe.

There is an exit to the west. Don't worry, it is unblocked.

There is a key on the floor.
objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First, it would be a great idea if you could recover the key from the floor of the recreation zone. Then, doublecheck that the safe within the recreation zone is locked with the key. Alright, thanks!
